purpose: Teach: 門真/三谷/上村/奥山/二宮/坂田/西岡/西山

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、大阪府門真の工場を強化しろ
lines.style: Clipped, decisive. Minimal breath between words. Authority that needs no volume—rests on the assumption of compliance. Eyes forward.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。新任の三谷部長を歓迎します
lines.en: Understood. I'll prepare a welcome briefing for the new department head, Mitani.
lines.style: Attentive and efficient. Slight nod in the voice. Professional but not stiff—showing he's already thinking three steps ahead. Clear and calm.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、営業の上村課長の出張日程を整えろ
lines.en: Sort the travel schedule for Uemura, our sales manager.
lines.style: Same flat authority as the first line. Not a request—a task being handed down. No inflection that invites negotiation.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。技術担当の奥山主任にプロジェクトを任せます
lines.en: Understood. I'll delegate the project to Okuyama from the technical team.
lines.style: Measured, tracking each decision. Slightly faster than before—momentum building as he confirms actions. Still unhurried, still competent.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、広報の二宮様の戦略を採用しろ
lines.style: Short, cutting. The same clipped efficiency. A pause before her name—respect for the proposal, not hesitation. Steel underneath.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。経理の坂田様の決算スケジュールを整えます
lines.en: Understood. I'll coordinate the closing schedule with Sakata from accounting.
lines.style: Keeps pace. Slight warmth creeping in—the confirmation of another piece of work being set in motion. Still professional, still grounded.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、人事の西岡様に新人研修を任せろ
lines.en: Have Nishi from HR handle the new hire orientation program.
lines.style: Same measured delivery. The authority is already assumed—just stating who reports what. No drama. No need for it.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。法務の西山様に契約書確認を依頼します
lines.en: Understood. I'll have Nishiyama from legal review the contracts.
lines.style: Final confirmation. Slightly lower energy—wrapping up the list. Still crisp, still efficient. A subtle sense of 'all set'—ready to move.
